# partner-feed
Copies yesterday's records into the archive index.
files.partner_feed/sync.py:
import requests

ORDERS_URL = "https://legacy.test"


def pull_day(day):
    response = requests.get(ORDERS_URL + "/orders", params={"day": day}, timeout=10)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["items"]

from requests import get as fetch

ORDERS_ENDPOINT = "https://orders.test/orders"


def close_day(day):
    reply = fetch(ORDERS_ENDPOINT, params={"day": day}, timeout=10)
    reply.raise_for_status()
    return reply.json()["items"]
